description: Create 5 distinct professional theme layout files in resources/views/themes/ and wire ThemeService to switch layouts. Each layout has a visually distinct structure matching real-world professional sites. FrontendComposer shares the active layout path with all frontend views so they can @extends($activeLayout).
steps: Create directory resources/views/themes/ (it does not exist yet).

Create resources/views/themes/modern-corporate.blade.php: Sticky white header, max-w-7xl boxed content, thin top accent bar in primary color, professional sans-serif. Structure: same sections as app.blade.php (header/main/footer) but with a 3px primary-color top border, slightly taller logo area (h-20), and a breadcrumb bar between header and main content. Copy app.blade.php as base and apply these structural differences.

Create resources/views/themes/creative-agency.blade.php: Transparent header that becomes white on scroll (Alpine.js scrolled state already in app.blade.php — keep it), full-width hero support, gradient accent in footer. Header text is white when not scrolled (uses :class binding). Remove the right-border CTA button style; replace with an outline button. Full-width layout (no max-w constraint on body).

Create resources/views/themes/minimalist-blog.blade.php: Serif font (load Merriweather from Google Fonts), narrow max-w-3xl centered layout for main content, minimal header (logo + nav only, no CTA button, no search), simple text-only footer with centered links. Clean whitespace-focused design.

Create resources/views/themes/tech-startup.blade.php: Dark gradient header (bg-gradient-to-r from slate-900 to-slate-800), logo in white, nav links in slate-300 hover:white, CTA button in primary. Body has subtle dark pattern (use tech-grid-pattern class already in app.css). Footer is dark gradient (use existing bg-dark). Load Space Grotesk font from Google Fonts.

Create resources/views/themes/dark-mode-elegant.blade.php: Forces dark mode always — add class='dark' on <html> unconditionally, use bg-dark (#0f172a) body, purple/indigo accent colors (override --theme-primary inline to #8E44AD if no active theme). Elegant serif heading font (load Playfair Display). Header is dark with border-b border-white/10. All card backgrounds are #1e293b.

Add method getActiveLayout(): string to app/Services/ThemeService.php. Map theme slug to layout path: 'modern-corporate' => 'themes.modern-corporate', 'creative-agency' => 'themes.creative-agency', 'minimalist-blog' => 'themes.minimalist-blog', 'tech-startup' => 'themes.tech-startup', 'dark-mode-elegant' => 'themes.dark-mode-elegant'. For any other slug (or no active theme), return 'frontend.layouts.app'. If the resolved view does not exist (View::exists check), fall back to 'frontend.layouts.app'.

In app/View/Composers/FrontendComposer.php, add ThemeService injection to constructor (add protected ThemeService $themeService parameter). In compose() method, inside the try block, call $activeLayout = $this->themeService->getActiveLayout(); and add 'activeLayout' to the $view->with(compact(...)) call. Also update the catch block to set $activeLayout = 'frontend.layouts.app';.

Update FrontendComposer to attach to ALL frontend views (not just the layout). In AppServiceProvider::boot(), change View::composer('frontend.layouts.app', FrontendComposer::class) to View::composer('frontend.*', FrontendComposer::class). This ensures $activeLayout is available in all frontend views.

Update ALL frontend page views to use @extends($activeLayout ?? 'frontend.layouts.app') instead of @extends('frontend.layouts.app'): resources/views/frontend/page/show.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/page/builder.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/page/kontak.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/page/layanan.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/page/tentang-kami.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/home.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/blog/index.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/blog/show.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/search.blade.php, resources/views/frontend/maintenance.blade.php.
Also update resources/views/frontend/newsletter/confirmed.blade.php and resources/views/frontend/newsletter/unsubscribed.blade.php to use the dynamic extends.

Verify that each of the 5 new theme layout files properly includes @yield('content'), @yield('scripts'), @stack('head'), and the AlpineJS CDN script tag (copy from app.blade.php). Each theme layout must also call the theme CSS variable injection added in FEAT-006.
acceptance_criteria: ThemeService::getActiveLayout() returns the correct view name for each of the 5 slugs and falls back to 'frontend.layouts.app' for unknown slugs
Activating 'tech-startup' theme in admin and visiting homepage shows dark gradient header
Activating 'minimalist-blog' theme shows narrow centered content with serif font
php artisan view:clear && php artisan test — no regressions
verification: php artisan view:clear && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear
Visit /admin/themes, activate 'Tech Startup', visit frontend homepage — confirm dark gradient header
Activate 'Modern Corporate', visit frontend — confirm standard white sticky header
npm run build (must complete without errors)
